description: Utility functions for object property access, file upload, data transformation, and route query parameter handling in a Vue 3 project.

methods.name: getNestedProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a nested property from an object using a dot-notation path.

methods.name: uploadRecipeImage
methods.description: Uploads an image file for a recipe via a PUT request, handling CSRF token and error messaging.

methods.name: toNumberArray
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings into an array of numbers.

methods.name: stringToBool
methods.description: Converts 'true'/'false' strings to boolean values, returns undefined otherwise.
